# form.addBooleanField

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Add a boolean field to the current form.

```lua
form.addBooleanField(line, rect, getValue, setValue)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `line` | FormLine | yes | the line where the field should be added |
| `rect` | Rect | yes | the coordinates |
| `getValue` | function | yes | the function which will return the current value |
| `setValue` | function | yes | the function which will be called on value change |

## Returns

The new field

## Examples

```lua
local line = form.addLine("Voice alerts")
form.addBooleanField(line, nil,
  function() return config.voice end,
  function(v) config.voice = v end)
```

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
form.addBooleanField(line, nil, function() return value end, function(newValue) value = newValue end)
```

=== "Example 1"

    ```lua
    formFieldCount = formFieldCount + 1

    dashx.app.formFields[formFieldCount] = form.addBooleanField(dashx.app.formLines[dashx.session.formLineCnt], nil, function() if dashx.preferences and dashx.preferences.developer then return settings['devtools'] end end,
    ```
